intro: A bright game counter hums with flashing lights. The attendant gives you a practiced smile, ushering you toward the tables.
title: Game Corner
description: A small game corner has opened for passing trainers. Test your luck, keep your nerve, and cash out before Voltorb ruins the run.

1.label: Voltorb Flip
1.tooltip: (?) Reveal cards and cash out before your third Voltorb
1.selected: You sit down at the Voltorb Flip table.

2.label: Slot Machine
2.selected: The slot machine is out of service for now.

3.label: Stake-Out
3.selected: You and {{option3PrimaryName}} case the game corner, eventually following a suspicious man to a secret elevator!

4.label: Leave
4.selected: You step away from the game counter.

stakeOutPlaceholder: The trail is promising, but the hidden elevator is not ready yet.

voltorbFlip.start: The cards are shuffled and dealt face-down.
voltorbFlip.cashOut: You end the game early and collect your nuggies.
voltorbFlip.firstVoltorb: A Voltorb! The table sparks, but the game keeps going.
voltorbFlip.secondVoltorb: Another Voltorb! One more mistake will end the game.
voltorbFlip.thirdVoltorb: A third Voltorb explodes across the board! Your winnings are lost.
voltorbFlip.perfectClear: You reveal every safe card and clear the board!

rewardCounter.title: Prize Counter
rewardCounter.cashOutDesc: Trade your remaining nuggies for money and leave the counter.
rewardCounter.notEnough: You do not have enough nuggies for that prize.
